items.title: Houston Person Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995…
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember John Heard trying to define jazz for us...

ctx.x: Polkas have Polish polkas, every culture has dance. Every culture has a dance associated with its music.
I remember John Heard trying to define jazz for us and the only way he could describe it was it’s a dance.

Yeah. But when you eliminate elements, you lose some of the essence, to me, that’s just to me. Now there are parts of it where, as in any culture too, where you have a music that you listen to. You go to the opera and you sit and you listen. But dance is represented in some way because you’re going to have a ballet or some sort of dance.
